brief:
Resistance security sources revealed intelligence indicating an alleged Israeli plan to stage a false-flag operation in Gaza, Shehab Wire reported. According to the sources, the scheme would involve coordination with what they termed "collaborationist gangs" to orchestrate a fabricated kidnapping of an Israeli soldier, with the aim of blaming Palestinian resistance movements for the incident.

The disclosure comes as part of broader resistance faction claims about Israeli military operations in Gaza. The sources did not provide specific details about timing or target locations for the alleged plot.
dek: Resistance security sources revealed intelligence indicating an alleged Israeli plan to stage a false-flag operation in Gaza, Shehab Wire reported.
title: Resistance security warns of Israeli plot targeting Gaza
